RecordGroup.Name: RG_FIND
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, name, phone, to_char(pickup_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') pickup from mm_reservation order by pickup_date desc, id desc

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ITEMR
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, code || ' ' || name text from mm_item where active = 'Y' and is_model = 'N' and serial_tracked = 'N' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PAY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select 'CASH' code, mm_text.t('T360189BA') descr from dual union all select 'CARD' code, mm_text.t('T74C8F084') descr from dual
